notes.claim: UK low-voltage supplies are declared at a frequency of 50 hertz and a voltage of 230 volts between the phase and neutral conductors at the supply terminals, unless otherwise agreed in writing.
Low voltage in building supplies is described as 400 V three-phase and 230 V single-phase; these are nominal voltages.

sources.title: The Electricity Safety, Quality and Continuity Regulations 2002
sources.quote: shall be 50 hertz and the voltage declared in respect of a low voltage supply shall be 230 volts between the phase and neutral conductors at the supply terminals.

sources.title: Low voltage
sources.quote: Low voltage is a term used to describe 400 V three-phase and 230 V single-phase supplies.
